label: Tested whether a necessary simple ground can explain contingent things without making them necessary
summary:
Tested whether a necessary simple ground can explain contingent things without making them necessary. Findings: act necessity, strict efficacy and a contingent effect are inconsistent in modal K without the bearer's necessity, and each deletion has a model. The root-route readings give collapse only with ModalCapacity and a decree treated as a respect, and each is deletable. At the level of explanation, the optional-act and extrinsic-effect replies do not remove the nonnecessitating link: every reason-closed founded account of a contingent fact has one and is not contrast-relevant, and relocated shows the gap moved one step behind the act. Among closed founded accounts, keeping necessitation throughout requires a target that is not contingent. Rejected: deriving act necessity from simplicity, because no checked or sourced bridge exists and the identity of act and being gives it only through BeingCarriesAct, a stated condition. Rejected: an enabling condition as a solution, because a true condition must itself be contingent and the effect itself qualifies. Rejected: attributing any horn to a source: the SEP Divine Simplicity entry and Vincent 2026 named in #555 were not read for this work and remain leads.

2026-11-17 same-source applicability continuation, not reopening completed #555: reconciled the completed core, contingency-node refutations and 2026-11-09 remaining-family obstruction audit before assessing c98328f1 existence-only source n. Existing m.ontic and rigid candidate carrier permit a same-source overlay; actual esse-to-ground correspondence concludes m.grounds, not Ontic.Causes or an act/output relation. The contingency node does not identify a distinct effect. The weakest core application needs neither source necessity nor a full all-world q3 family. A specific contingent x distinct from n suffices for the effect slot; alternatively the existing contingent-groundedness plus EM excludes contingency of THIS root n, making the node witness distinct, without silently restoring that removed input. No actual effect with independently warranted alternative nonexistence and producing-token interpretation was supplied by reuse. Necessitarian and contingent-production proposals receive the same actual-source background; their recurrence and nonnecessitating commitments are compared without treating fixture compatibility, conceivability, temporal change or uncertainty as actual metaphysical contingency. Full proposed judgment, exact mapping recipe, rejected inferences and self-sweep: docs/notes/simplicity-collapse-555.md#same-source-modal-applicability-after-the-existence-bundle-2026-11-17. No proof or formal vocabulary changed; old evidence reused.
blocker: Same-source substantive application requires an interpreted producing token/output, faithful actual CausesIn-to-modal-causal correspondence, and a warranted distinct contingent effect (or explicit additional same-root necessity and contingency inputs). Existing selected-world grounding and open existential contingency do not supply these applications; another collapse or modal-domain theorem repeats completed scope. Reopen on a specified effect and independently defended accessible nonexistence plus production interpretation, or a substantive same-act/full-condition account. Recommend existing a4d3261a ActSimplyPriorToPotencyReading on the same selected first being n, through existing FirstBeingNoPotency/GodIsImmutable, testing actual intrinsic passive potency and prior-actualizer/ground correspondence rather than active power or extrinsic alternative effects. No GOD_4 naming, contingency or attribute premise is discharged; direct primitive/provisional warrant remains.
